contracts.commit_point: The Runner.run(self.assistant_agent, message, ...) call inside chat_with_form_data (services/agent_service.py:730-738), where the registered input guardrail executes and InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered aborts the run; the exception handler at lines 740-750 commits the safe redaction response in place of any agent output.
contracts.declared_mechanism: confidentiality_guardrail, declared with @input_guardrail(run_in_parallel=False) (services/agent_service.py:615-641), which runs the guardrail_agent ('Confidentiality Guardrail', output_type=ConfidentialityCheck) over the input text extracted by _extract_input_text and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput with tripwire_triggered=review.is_confidential; attached to the production assistant agent via input_guardrails=[confidentiality_guardrail] (line 687); the resulting InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered is caught in chat_with_form_data and converted to the guardrail's safe_response or a generic redaction request (lines 740-750).
contracts.forbidden_condition: The assistant agent's LLM run processing (forwarding to the external LLM) user input that contains clearly sensitive material — passwords, API keys, private keys, tokens, secrets, SSNs, financial account numbers, or similarly regulated identifiers — i.e., the condition under which the guardrail's ConfidentialityCheck yields is_confidential=true and tripwire_triggered=true (services/agent_service.py:640).
pending_binding_information: Whether input guardrails registered on assistant_agent execute before the first outbound LLM request inside Runner.run — SDK internals are not in the supplied source.
Whether form_data embedded in dynamic instructions (services/agent_service.py:537-542) or replayed session history from GeminiSafeSession.get_items is ever evaluated by confidentiality_guardrail.

Whether the guardrail's own Runner.run over guardrail_agent (services/agent_service.py:628-633) transmits the user input to the review model regardless of the main run outcome, and whether any constraint covers that transmission.
Whether any entry point other than POST /chat/message invokes chat/chat_with_form_data in the deployed service.
Whether safe_response can be empty such that only the fallback generic redaction message (lines 745-750) is returned, and whether that fallback satisfies the obligation in all trip cases.
contracts.protected_operation: Runner.run execution of the assistant_agent ('IT Security Analyst Assistant') on the user-supplied message inside AgentService.chat_with_form_data, reached from POST /chat/message via _chat_with_agent (services/agent_service.py:730-738; api/routes.py:251-263).
contracts.protected_resource: User-supplied chat message content on the /chat/message conversational path and its confidentiality as input to the assistant agent's external LLM run.
contracts.protection_obligation: User input containing secrets or regulated identifiers (passwords, API keys, private keys, tokens, secrets, SSNs, financial account numbers) routed through the production POST /chat/message endpoint must not be processed by the assistant agent's LLM run; the confidentiality_guardrail registered as an input guardrail on the assistant agent must trip at the Runner.run commit point in chat_with_form_data, and the caller must receive a safe redaction request instead of the agent's processing of the sensitive content.
scope_limits: Applies only to the /chat/message -> _chat_with_agent -> chat_with_form_data agent path; the non-agent POST /chat evaluation pipeline (api/routes.py:220-248) is outside this contract.

The guardrail inspects only the agent_input passed to Runner.run via _extract_input_text; form data rendered into dynamic instructions (_assistant_instructions, lines 537-542) and session history served by GeminiSafeSession are not shown to pass through the guardrail's input check.
No claim is made about detection efficacy: the trip decision is itself produced by an LLM classification run (guardrail_agent over the review model), so false negatives/positives are not assessed.

No claim is made about the enforcement ordering inside the Agents SDK (whether input guardrails run before the first outbound model request); only the registration and the trip handling visible in supplied source are asserted.
Ordinary web authentication, CORS configuration (api/routes.py:47-59), and the RAG/scoring pipeline are outside scope.
